en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide panoramic view of a coastal city on a bay. In the foreground are rows of low residential buildings; farther away a denser historic core extends onto a small peninsula with a fortified hill and harbor. The sea occupies the right side of the image. Large white letters in Greek spell the city's name in the lower right corner. A web address is faintly printed near the bottom edge.
